items.summary: An open-source client (Apache-2.0, desktop and mobile) that links multiple computers and phones into a single agent workspace: a session started on one device can continue on another, and configured models and subscriptions can be reused across devices, while the phone can operate a connected computer through a built-in remote desktop. Claude Code, Codex, Pi and other harnesses can be switched mid-task with the workspace and memory kept continuous; v0.1.121 shipped on October 30. The backend service is not part of this open repository.
items.title: Cindy: open-source cross-device AI agent linking computers and phones into one workspace

items.summary: An open-source multi-agent orchestration environment (MIT): one instruction is fanned out to several CLI coding agents at once, each working in its own isolated git worktree so runs never overwrite each other, and results are compared side by side before the best one is merged. A headless server mode and a mobile companion allow an agent fleet to be monitored and steered remotely. v1.4.245 shipped on October 30, with about 6,800 new stars in the past 7 days.
items.title: Orca: run multiple coding agents in parallel, each in an isolated worktree, and merge the winner

items.summary: Open weights released on November 1, 2026 for a 27B decision model: instead of generating text, it returns a probability for each given option, suited to routing, classification and policy checks inside agents. It ships as bf16, Q8_0 GGUF and Q4 checkpoints; the Q4 build runs on Apple Silicon machines with 24GB or more, while Q8_0 requires 48GB.
items.title: Drex Max v1 open weights: a 27B decision model that runs locally on Apple Silicon
